decision.next_action: request source mol2/RESP/frcmod/tleap and starting coordinates; validate the compiled charges and GAFF terms against those files before parent PaG work

limitations: The published architecture is reconciled at molecular-graph and formula level, not by an author-supplied atom-name map.
AMBER atom types and numerical terms remain compiled outputs whose source derivation is unavailable.
Formula and motif agreement do not validate partial charges, protonation, conformational sampling, or transferability.
The simulated object is the methyl-truncated public host, not full receptor 2 or the NNC2215 conjugate.
not_target_claim: not complete receptor 2, not NNC2215, not PaG or MC-Q1 affinity, not efficacy, safety, or a drug result

primary_sources.evidence: 2019 receptor design and synthesis figures show two triethyl aromatic caps, three benzamide-containing pillars, six urea bridges, and three outer solubilising amide substituents.
2026 methods state that the polycarboxylate dendrimer was removed at the outer amide linker and replaced with methyl for the simulation model.

scope: public truncated GluHUT host graph in four deposited AMBER systems
